description: A project's SynaBun Style Guide: brand, colors (light/dark), type, spacing, motion, components and rules, as a summary, the full DESIGN.md or tokens (CSS variables, Tailwind theme, W3C design tokens). Call it BEFORE UI, design, copy, marketing, image or video work and use its tokens instead of inventing values. Pass projectPath (your working directory). To change the guide, use action "propose": the user reviews proposals; never edit DESIGN.md or the token files by hand.

action.description: "summary": the compact brand block (start here). "get": summary + the full DESIGN.md (or one `section`). "tokens": the tokens in a `format`. "contrast": WCAG ratio + APCA for `fg` on `bg`. "propose": suggest a change (`changes` + `reason`) for the user to review. "proposals": list them. "export": write DESIGN.md and the token files into the project now. "list": registered projects and whether each has a guide.

bg.description: contrast: the background color, same forms as fg.

changes.description: propose: a JSON merge patch (RFC 7396) against the guide, e.g. {"colors":{"status":{"danger":"#dc2626"}}}. null deletes a key. agents and exports settings cannot be proposed.

fg.description: contrast: the text color — a hex, rgb(), hsl(), oklch(), or an alias like "{semantic.text}" or "{primary.500}".

format.description: tokens: "json" (resolved values, default), "dtcg" (W3C design tokens), "css" (custom properties), "tailwind-v4" (@theme) or "tailwind-v3" (theme.extend).

formats.description: export: which files to write (default: the ones the guide has enabled).

model.description: propose: the authoring model, if known.

projectPath.description: The project root or any path inside it (your working directory). The default is the server's cwd, which is usually NOT your project — pass it.

provider.description: propose: the authoring provider, if known.

reason.description: propose: why the guide should change (required).

runId.description: propose: the dispatched run id, if known.

section.description: get: only this DESIGN.md section, e.g. "Colors", "Typography", "Components", "Do's and Don'ts".

size.description: contrast: "large" for text ≥ 24px (or ≥ 18.66px bold) and UI components.

taskClass.description: summary: the kind of work (e.g. "image_gen" or "video_gen" puts imagery and the generation prefix first).

theme.description: tokens / contrast: one theme (default: the guide's default theme).

name: style_guide
